limitations: Announcements and utility contracts are guidance, not commissioned load.
Only IT and explicitly electrical capacity enter normalized demand; generation and unspecified MW stay separate.
Modeling undisclosed supplier allocation as a potential procurement pool does not prove an open tender.
No independent execution-qualified open MW or shortage duration established.
Default 2028 phase and bridge fractions are team assumptions and editable; a service-ready date is not assigned to unknown cases.
